dayShift.name: Margot
dayShift.title: Shop Owner
dayShift.greeting: Welcome. Everything is priced fairly — by my standards.
dayShift.shiftEndLine: I'll be here until the next server arrives — {time} away. No rush.
dialogues: Browse at your leisure. I don't do pushy.
All sales final. That's not negotiable.
I've been running this shop for twelve years. I know value when I see it.
The rare cards are there for a reason — don't ask me to move them.
Take your time. Rushing leads to buyer's remorse.

dayShift.name: Vesna
dayShift.title: Card Specialist
dayShift.greeting: I know cards. These three? Hand-picked. You're welcome.
dayShift.shiftEndLine: My shift ends in {time}. But I'm busy! These cards don't curate themselves.
dialogues: Each card in my selection has a purpose. Can you see it?
I spent three hours on this stock. Three. Hours.
You won't find better picks anywhere this side of the Verdant Shard.
A bad card in the wrong deck is worse than no card at all.
Trust the curation. I haven't been wrong yet — this week.

dayShift.name: Aldric
dayShift.title: Wandering Dealer
dayShift.greeting: Passing through. Today's selection is purely coincidental. Or is it?
dayShift.shiftEndLine: I move on in {time}. Make your choice — I don't wait.
dialogues: I travel light. But my stock? Always interesting.
Ask me where I got these and I'll ask you to mind your business.
Tomorrow I'm two shards away. Today, I'm here. Lucky you.
Every item I carry has a story. Most of them are true.
I've seen four of the five shards. The fifth one tried to keep me.

dayShift.name: Pip
dayShift.title: Apprentice (Day)
dayShift.greeting: Um, hi! I'm looking after the shop today. I think.
dayShift.shiftEndLine: Only {time} left on my shift... not that I'm counting.
dialogues: Margot said not to touch the back shelves. So obviously I've already touched them.
I'm pretty sure these prices are right. Pretty sure.
Don't ask me about the legendary cards. I'm not allowed to discuss the legendary cards.
I may have rearranged a few things. It's fine. Probably.
If anything seems off, that's... a known issue.

dayShift.name: Seraph
dayShift.title: Archivist
dayShift.greeting: The collection doesn't grow by itself. Invest wisely.
dayShift.shiftEndLine: I leave in {time}. Choose before the shop closes.
dialogues: I have catalogued every card ever printed. These three are worth your attention.
A strong collection is built card by card, not pack by pack.
The rarest card is worthless in the wrong hands. You don't have the wrong hands. Probably.
I keep records. Every sale, every trade. History matters.
Expansion sets come and go. Core cards endure.

dayShift.name: Lysandra
dayShift.title: Legendary Broker
dayShift.greeting: Rare finds don't come cheap. But they do come available — if you know where to look.
dayShift.shiftEndLine: I'm closing in {time}. Opportunities like this don't linger.
dialogues: I deal exclusively in the extraordinary. Everything else bores me.
That legendary on the shelf? I turned down three offers before yours.
You either see the value or you don't. I can't teach taste.
My clients never regret buying from me. Only not buying.
One legendary, one chance, one day. That's always how it works.

nightShift.name: Grix
nightShift.title: Goblin Night Trader
nightShift.greeting: Psst. Grix open late. Very secret. Very good deals. Mostly.
nightShift.shiftEndLine: Grix go home in {time}. Very tired goblin.
dialogues: Grix not normally do this. But Grix need crystals. Bad.
Is fine. Everything legitimate. Grix promise.
You not tell anyone you see Grix here, yes?
Grix got good stuff tonight. Better than last night. Last night was accident.
Grix like night shift. No questions. Very professional.

nightShift.name: Nox
nightShift.title: Nocturnal Curator
nightShift.greeting: The serious collectors shop at night. Good to see you.
nightShift.shiftEndLine: The night shift ends in {time}. The serious ones don't dawdle.
dialogues: Daytime shoppers browse. Night shoppers buy. Which are you?
My selection changes with the moon. Metaphorically. The stock rotates every three hours.
Quiet in here. I like it. Less noise. Better decisions.
I've never once sold a card to someone I regretted selling to. Tonight continues that record.
The rarest cards surface at night. So do the most discerning buyers.

nightShift.name: Pip
nightShift.title: Apprentice (Night)
nightShift.greeting: Margot said I could do the night shift. This is fine. Everything is fine.
nightShift.shiftEndLine: Only {time} to go... then I can sleep.
dialogues: It's not as spooky as I expected. Mostly.
I keep hearing noises from the stockroom. Margot said to ignore them.
Night shift pay is the same as day shift pay. I checked.
I've reorganised the shelves twice. Third time is for fun.
Did you know this shop has a basement? I found out an hour ago. I'm not going back.

nightShift.name: The Stranger
nightShift.title: Unknown Origin
dialogues: (...nods slightly.)
(...gestures vaguely at the stock.)

nightShift.name: Cass
nightShift.title: Off-Duty Guard
nightShift.greeting: Not usually my job, but here we are. Don't tell Margot.
nightShift.shiftEndLine: Back on duty in {time}. Margot better not find out about this.
dialogues: I'm trained to spot trouble. You don't look like trouble. Mostly.
Guard pay doesn't cover what it used to. Hence... this.
I keep my hand near my sword out of habit. Don't read into it.
Margot would kill me if she knew. Worth it.
I've learned more about card pricing tonight than in three years of guarding.

nightShift.name: Vorn
nightShift.title: Shadow Merchant
nightShift.greeting: I only come out at night. And I only deal in the extraordinary.
nightShift.shiftEndLine: My dealings conclude in {time}. The shadows are patient — I am not.
dialogues: I have no permanent address. I have only tonight's offer.
The card I carry is unique. Once it's gone, so am I.
Day merchants deal in abundance. I deal in scarcity.
You found me. That's already rare. The card makes it rarer.
Ask me nothing. Buy or don't. I'll be gone by sunrise either way.
